svg.title: Aspect method development
svg.desc: FinBERT sentence embeddings are reduced with UMAP and clustered with HDBSCAN; the clusters were labelled into ten aspects. Seed-centroid assignment by cosine similarity was calibrated against the human aspect labels and found weak at any floor. A local LLM choosing one aspect from a fixed list was evaluated on the same labels and was far better, more so where two models agree; Opus 5.5 gives a reference. The classifier's answers for the corpus are being cached; applying them, and distilling them into a smaller model, wait.
